references.text: The chapter provides a complete list of unclean animals that could not be offered to the Lord, which explains the concept of 'unclean animal' in Leviticus 27:11.
The preceding verses deal with clean animals that can be offered to the Lord, in contrast to the unclean animals mentioned in verse 11.
The following verse describes the priest's valuation of the unclean animal and the possibility of redemption.
It deals with the redemption of unclean animals and the priest's role in valuation, parallel to the principles in Leviticus 27:11.
It provides a list of clean and unclean animals, elaborating on the distinction between animals that could and could not be offered.
